verses.1: A prayer for destruction over the eighth one, for David.
verses.2: The LORD will save those who are righteous, because they have abandoned falsehoods among human beings.
verses.3: Let people speak to each other with heartfelt words, in a sincere manner.
verses.4: The LORD will make all those who speak evil words into instruments for speaking great things.
verses.5: They said to us, “Increase our lips. Let them speak for us.” Who will be our advocate?
verses.6: From the poor who are under the burden of their ancestors’ sins, now I will stand up. I will say, “Lord, I will restore him to his former state.”
verses.7: The words of Jehovah are pure and holy. They are like gold that has been refined in the furnace. They are worthy to be placed upon the earth. Seven times over.
verses.8: You, Jehovah, will protect them and keep them safe from all harm forever.
verses.9: Around the wicked, they walk like roaming wolves among human beings.
